question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution mentions that for every state there shall be a Legislature?
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Article 168**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Article 168 states that **every state shall have a legislature which shall consist of the Governor**.

 
 
• The following states shall have **2 Houses of Legislature: Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh**.
